identityTest.stableIdentity: One employer-scoped worker profile survives employee-number changes, assignment changes, separation and later rehire while preserving the same person and employing-party scope.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Changes to profile numbering, validity, category assertions or source employment references create effective-dated profile versions without changing the person or employment records they reference.

owns: dated employee-number bindings by numbering scheme
references to one or more employment or engagement records
worker-category assertions with purpose jurisdiction source and validity
rehire continuity and profile succession history

references.purpose: Employment, contractor or agency engagement records
Joiner, mover or leaver case handling when represented as a case

excludes: person identity or cross-employer worker identity
position, assignment, employer or host identity
access entitlement, account or revocation authority
legal classification inferred from a category label

invariants: A profile is scoped to exactly one person and one employing party.
Employee numbers are unique only within employer, numbering scheme and validity interval.
An employee number is never a person identifier or cross-employer join key.
Profile existence never proves active employment, contractor status or legal classification.
Every referenced assignment resolves to one explicit employment or engagement context.
Agency labor distinguishes employing agency, work customer and staffing supplier roles.
A new employing party, engagement basis, rehire after separation or parallel contract creates a new employment record.
A post, host, scope or authority change creates a new assignment rather than a new person or profile.
Separation preserves the ended employment record and its effective basis and time.
Rehire may reuse the employer-scoped profile but must reference a new employment record.
Offboarding creates verification obligations and never implies that access was revoked.
Closed, inactive and superseded profiles remain resolvable for historical attribution.
holds: Registry identifier allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.
Parent models are not canonical and WM-ORG-005 carries a review waiver.
Access-revocation and joiner-mover-leaver fixtures require cross-model validation.
